params.prompt: A hairline line drawing in one single red ink on pure white paper, in the manner of an architect's first site sketch made before anything is built: one confident continuous pen weight throughout, open linework, no shading, no hatching, no fills, no grey tones, no second colour, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos. A few short dimension ticks along one edge of the path and one small registration cross in a corner, as on a plan. Generous white space, the drawing sitting in the middle two thirds of the sheet. Portrait format. Subject: a newly paved public cycle path curving from the lower left foreground away into the middle distance, bending right past a low modern campus building with a wide overhanging flat roof and a long glass wall, loose strokes of tall prairie grasses either side of the path, a freshly cleared corner plot in the lower right with three survey stakes, one cyclist seen from behind riding away on the path in the middle distance, a few trees drawn as simple rounded outlines, a flat horizon with a second low building far off, the sky left as empty paper.
